tutorials.title: Multiworld Setup Guide
tutorials.description: A guide to setting up Nova Lands for MultiWorld.
tutorials.text:
# How to use
- Install MelonLoader
- Drop the Mod and its Dependency in the mods folder

notes.text:
# What's new?
- added the option to make the museum locations (each diorama or each room)
- added four traps
- added more customization options
# How to use
- Install the latest version of [MelonLoader](https://melonwiki.xyz/#/?id=automated-installation)
- place ``NovaLandsArchipelago.dll`` and ``Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dl`` in the Mods folder
- upon launching Nova Lands there might be a few errors in the MelonLoader console, you can ignore those
- connect to a slot via the box on the left of the screen
# What's randomized?
- Researches are locations
- Mseum progress and boss defeats are optional locations
- research is received as an item (it has to be researched again to get the effect. if you don't have the item it won't take ressources and only send the check)
# Goal options
- Each of the three bosses
- a configurable number of museum dioramas complete
# This release is not compatible with 0.1.x
